# smart-trust-catalogue

Qualified Dublin Core (`folio-dublin-core/v1`) and catalogue node (`folio-catalogue-node/v1`) records for two kinds of item: the document materialized in `library/` (the GDHCN Administrative and Operational Framework 1.2), and every work the IG cites that is not ingested, as a `referenced` item whose record is the IG's bibliography entry for it, keyed by the citation (`#ref-<slug>`). A capture of a cited work, when one exists, is kept in the repository's `uploads/` data store, which is not part of the KG. `bun run cat check:catalogue` and `bun run cat check:materialized-fixity` verify every node, metadataRef, libraryId, localPath and SHA-256 digest.

Part of [WHO SMART Trust](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-trust-catalogue`, holding `catalogue`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`catalogue.json`](catalogue.json) | WHO SMART Trust — GDHCN Source Documents Catalogue |  |
| [`nodes/`](nodes/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
| [`records/`](records/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
